executive_summary: Canada is experiencing a severe ransomware crisis with 105 organizations publicly listed as victims in the past 48 hours, including critical infrastructure targets like Canada Goose, Peterborough Public Health, Eastern Townships School Board, and National Money Mart (database leaked). The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security has issued two critical advisories: CVE-2026-45659 affecting Microsoft SharePoint Server and CVE-2026-8451 impacting Citrix NetScaler, both requiring immediate patching. The Qilin ransomware group alone has claimed 18 Canadian victims, followed by Play (10 victims), and Clop (14 victims), indicating coordinated campaigns against Canadian entities across all sectors.

canada_landscape.summary: Canada faces an unprecedented ransomware emergency with 105 organizations publicly breached in 48 hours across all sectors. CCCS has issued two critical vulnerability advisories (CVE-2026-45659 for SharePoint, CVE-2026-8451 for Citrix NetScaler) requiring immediate patching. Critical infrastructure victims include public health agencies, municipalities, school boards, telecommunications networks, and a major consumer brand.
canada_landscape.retailers: Canada Goose (consumer services/retail brand) compromised by CoinbaseCartel ransomware group; Active Green + Ross (automotive retail chain) compromised by Sinobi ransomware group
canada_landscape.financial: National Money Mart Company breached by Everest ransomware with database leaked; Morison Insurance Brokers compromised by Sinobi; Trucash compromised by Lynx; multiple accounting and financial services firms affected including Pewarchuk CPA, MG Chartered Professional Accountant, and Axion50plus

report_2w.executive_summary: Oracle E-Business Suite vulnerability CVE-2026-46817 is being actively exploited in the wild and has already compromised employee data at Nissan Americas. SimpleHelp CVE-2026-48558 (CVSS 10.0) is under active exploitation, deploying the Djinn Stealer and TaskWeaver malware. Aflac Japan disclosed a massive breach affecting 4.38 million customer records, while a Check Point VPN bypass (CVE-2026-50751) was leveraged by Qilin ransomware. Progress Kemp LoadMaster has a critical pre-authentication flaw allowing root command execution. No CCCS advisories or direct Canadian organizational impacts were identified in this period.
